definitions: A punctuation mark (') used to indicate either possession or the omission of letters or numbers.
An exclamatory passage in a speech or poem addressed to a person (typically one who is dead or absent) or thing (typically one that is personified and absent) that is not present.
examples: O, pardon me, thou bleeding piece of earth, that I am meek and gentle with these butchers!
Friends, Romans, countrymen, lend me your ears!
